why: newest release at least two weeks old (D1)
evidence: npm view pyodide time; 314.0.7 lock info

decision: lxml 6.1.3, Pillow 12.2.0, typing_extensions 4.15.0 from the Pyodide distribution
why: the distribution ships all three for this ABI; typing_extensions there is the same pure wheel the spec says to vendor
result: self-hosted from docs/ with the rest

decision: python-pptx 1.0.2 and XlsxWriter 3.2.9 vendored wheels
why: XlsxWriter 3.3.0 is 7 days old, under the two-week floor

decision: CPython venv pins the same lxml, Pillow, python-pptx, XlsxWriter, typing_extensions as the browser
why: C10 compares XML from both runtimes

decision: any DOCTYPE in any XML part is bad_file
why: OOXML parts never carry one; refusing all is a superset of 'DOCTYPE with entities'

decision: python-pptx parser left as shipped: resolve_entities=False, no_network and huge_tree at lxml defaults (on, off)
why: it only sees XML that passed deckfill's safe parser; test asserts it does not expand entities

decision: lying member size gives bad_file
why: Python zipfile reads at most the declared size, then the CRC fails; caps also counted on bytes read

decision: integrity check allows an empty r:id
why: PowerPoint writes r:id="" on action links (next slide); it names no relationship

decision: kept parts = parts reachable from the package root
why: python-pptx loads by walking relationships; an orphan member nothing points to is not part of the template's look

decision: remove the whole p14:sectionLst and custShowLst
why: every sample slide goes, so every section and custom show would be empty; new slides belong to none

decision: docProps/app.xml: Slides, Notes, HiddenSlides counts updated; TitlesOfParts left
why: titles are positional and localised; counts are what PowerPoint shows

decision: a bullet line between # and the first ## joins the subtitle, mark removed
why: D2 is silent; this loses no text

decision: ### and deeper headings are read as plain lines, warned heading_level
why: not part of D2; keeps the text

decision: a # line after the first ## is read as ## and warned second_title
why: D2 says at most one #; a late one is the second

decision: '-', '*', '1.', '1)' need a space after the mark; '•·‧', '1、', '一、' do not
why: so -5%, *重要*, 1.5 億 stay text

decision: plain lines take indent level like bullets; no bullet-off formatting is written
why: fill sets no paragraph formatting beyond level (D4)

decision: a # needs whitespace after it; '#標題' is a plain line
why: D2 format is '# '; avoids hashtags becoming titles

decision: typed layouts outside step 1's list (objTx, picTx, vertTx, blank) go to step 2
why: step 1 lists only these types
evidence: typed fixture: Content with Caption is two by step 2, after Two Content in order

decision: column pair = the two largest bodies that do not overlap horizontally, ordered by x
why: Comparison has two small header bodies and two content bodies; columns are the content ones

decision: when the class default and its named fallbacks have no destination, the first compatible layout in file order
why: D3 step 4 lists fallbacks for title, two, section only

decision: normAutofit is modelled at full size; only spAutoFit counts as shape autofit
why: Office's default body carries normAutofit; marking it unmodelled would mark nearly every slide; estimating at 100% is the conservative side

decision: percent line spacing = 1.2 em x percent; percent space before/after on the same scale; no space before the first paragraph; marL narrows the width
why: PowerPoint single spacing is about 1.2 em and ignores space before on the first paragraph

decision: footer step 3 applies when steps 1 and 2 found no example slide
why: a template whose only sample is a cover still has p:hf to follow for content slides

decision: step 2 skips title-class layouts on both sides: a new title-class slide only takes footers from step 1
why: spec text; C4 footer-active expects no footer on the title slide

decision: a copied footer goes only onto a layout that has that placeholder type; its idx is set to the layout's
why: a slide placeholder inherits its place from the layout by idx

decision: step 3 adds ftr only when the layout's footer placeholder holds text
why: an empty footer box is an empty box (C6)

decision: python-pptx default master: dt idx 10, ftr idx 11, sldNum idx 12 on the master and every layout; no p:hf; no slide shows them
why: D4 asks the seat to log it
result: footers added only by D4 rules

decision: main content types accepted: presentation, template, slideshow (rewritten to presentation); macro-enabled refused as not_pptx
why: python-pptx would open .pptm but macros are out of scope

decision: dotnet SDK install via dotnet-install.sh denied by the auto-mode permission classifier (Code from External), twice
why: handoff names that route; working around the classifier is not allowed
result: BLOCKED: needs Marco to run the install or allow it

decision: page loads deckfill as docs/py/deckfill.zip unpacked by pyodide.unpackArchive
why: one same-origin file, no micropip, no network resolution

decision: playwright-core 1.64.1 (2026-10-14) driving the cached chromium_headless_shell-1243 by executablePath
why: 1.64.1's own build (1248) is not cached; downloading browsers was not needed

decision: prompt opens 'Turn the notes I give you into...' so the same text works pasted with notes and as a skill body
why: C14 needs page prompt, PROMPT.md and skill body identical

decision: skill name kept as ppt-outline although Google's best-practice page suggests a verb-first name
why: spec D7 names it; the verb tip is a recommendation, the lowercase-hyphen rule is the requirement

decision: C15 ran on gemini-3.8-flash-medium via agy CLI, brief opens with a no-tools line
why: handoff route; the app run is C16

decision: five templates picked by the G0 criteria before any fill: HKUST template 15 (.potx, HK), EDB MPA 2022 (HK, Chinese layout names), Microsoft catalog business proposal (first listed), elderly.gov.hk DIY deck (HK), USC substitute-fonts wide (.potx)
why: honest selection: chosen on the spec's criteria, not on fill results
result: 4 of 5 clean by script and eye; C5 validator part NOT RUN

decision: HKUST templates 14 (73.7 MB) and 16 (58.7 MB) recorded outside the five
why: both exceed the D1b 50 MB file cap, which the seat may not raise; template 14 is refused too_big
result: flag to Fable: 2 of 3 HKUST MTPC templates are over the cap (12 MB PNGs)

decision: fill puts back the template's own bytes for every kept part whose meaning is unchanged (same resolved relationships, or equal C14N 2.0)
why: python-pptx re-sorts relationships by Id and makes absolute targets relative on save; C3 flagged this on EDB, elderly, Microsoft and USC, never on python-pptx-made fixtures
result: C3 clean on all four real fills; mutation caught

decision: G0 checker: a subtitle line matches level 0 in a subtitle box or level 1 as the first body paragraphs
why: D3 step 4 puts the subtitle into the body when no title layout fits (Microsoft, elderly); the old checker expected subtitle level only
result: text, order and levels otherwise exact

decision: HKUST template 15 refused no_text_layout counts as G0's fail
why: every layout holds only body placeholders, its title boxes included; D3 step 5 refuses it as written
evidence: layout dump of hkust-template15.potx: no title or ctrTitle placeholder in 8 layouts
result: flag to Fable: real templates put titles in body placeholders

decision: per-template G0 outputs (filled decks, renders, sheets) stay out of git
why: they carry third-party branding (EDB, Microsoft, USC, elderly.gov.hk) and the repo goes public at deploy

decision: custom fixture's right column made wider than its left
why: a 'bigger body first' column-order mutation survived C2 because both columns were equal; real two-column layouts are often unequal
result: both column-order mutations (bigger first, XML order) now fail C2

decision: fill writes each slide's own number into the cached text of every slidenum field it places
why: a copied field kept its source slide's text (Microsoft G0: 2 on every slide, 7 on slide 4); PowerPoint recomputes it, Quick Look, Finder and Drive previews do not (Fable QA point b)

decision: base policy adds img-src 'self' data:
why: Chrome asks the server for /favicon.ico unless the page names an icon; the data: icon makes no request, but default-src 'self' blocked it
evidence: first headless load: CSP violation on data:, favicon
result: no favicon request; data: makes no network request

decision: Pyodide 314.0.7 needs no script-src beyond 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'
why: spec asks for every extra source with a reason
evidence: headless load with the base policy: zero CSP violations, ready

decision: phone width (760 px or less) shows the explainer and copy-link button and does not load the engine; the engine loads if the window widens
why: spec does not guarantee the fill on phones; 20 MB of engine on a phone buys nothing
evidence: phone run: 7 requests, none to vendor/

decision: fonts subset by scripts/build_fonts.py: Noto Serif TC to the page's own glyphs (175 KB), Newsreader to Latin (133 KB), Mentron Serif as is (109 KB)
why: self-hosted, all loaded before ready; user text outside the subset falls back to the system serif
evidence: docs/fonts/; google/fonts ofl/newsreader and ofl/notoseriftc, sha256 8a08d13f... and 0077e18f...

decision: outline textarea uses the system monospace (ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas)
why: indents carry meaning in the outline (level 2), so columns must line up; system font, no request

decision: test hook window.__e2e (Pyodide handle) only when the URL hash is #e2e
why: C9 must prove Python's js.fetch and pyfetch are blocked; the hash never reaches the server and the hook adds no request

decision: a blocked worker counts as blocked when its script never runs: Chrome returns from new Worker() and fires an error event instead of throwing
why: first probe treated no-throw as allowed; a direct before/after probe showed the lockdown blocks the worker and no request is made
evidence: scratch wprobe: before ran, after error, server never saw the script
result: probe checks for a postMessage from the worker

decision: app.js sets packageBaseUrl to the vendor folder
why: Pyodide falls back to its jsdelivr CDN when packageBaseUrl is unset; setting it removes the only path to another origin
result: vendor strings allowlisted with reasons in c9_privacy.mjs

decision: link-out clicks are counted apart from page requests: they are the user's own navigations to fixed anchors, intercepted and not followed
why: spec asks to click each link-out; zero requests after ready is about the page
result: 1 navigation after ready (the clicked anchor), 0 page requests, 0 server hits

decision: _restore_kept compares XML parts by libxml2 serialisation of both parsed trees, not C14N 2.0
why: C14N 2.0 in lxml is pure Python: 5.6 s main-thread task on elderly.gov.hk in the browser, over C12's 3 s bar; a false 'different' only leaves python-pptx's bytes, which C3 flags
evidence: CPython profile: fill 3.06 s -> 0.69 s; browser longest task 5.61 s -> 1.55 s
result: C3 clean on all four G0 fills; 173 tests pass

decision: worst case built by qa/c12/make_worst.py: 49.8 MB file, 2,000 members, 284 MB uncompressed, 29.8 MB XML (parts just under 5 MiB), max ratio 23:1; outline 66 slides planning to 199
why: the largest input the D1b caps allow; the 200-slide cap binds before the 50,000-character cap on this template
result: longest task 4.27 s (bar 10); no cap lowered

decision: the working-state screenshot is the screencast frame painted just before the longest task
why: a CDP screenshot waits for the main thread, so it can only be taken after the task; the frame on screen during the task is the last one painted before it
evidence: qa/e2e/c12-working-during-longest-task.png: overlay pixel 255, frame 11 ms before the 4.27 s task

decision: warm visit measured as a second navigation; the headless context's memory cache does not keep the 9.6 MB pyodide.asm.wasm, so it is downloaded again
why: page.reload() revalidates every file, which a returning visitor does not do; a persistent profile hung in headless shell
evidence: scratch warm.mjs: only pyodide.asm.wasm hit the server on the second visit
result: 5.0 s at the 5 s bar, pessimistic; real Chrome with a disk cache keeps the wasm

decision: SCRATCH=hkust14: read of the 73.7 MB HKUST template with Python caps raised for that run only
why: Fable asked for the numbers behind a rev 5 cap decision
result: read 276 ms, longest task 281 ms, wasm heap 45 -> 471 MB; shipped cap unchanged

decision: MAX_TOTAL lowered from the rev 5 150 MB to 130 MB (130 x 1024 x 1024); MAX_FILE 100 MB as rev 5
why: C12 rev 5 bar: wasm heap at the worst case 1.5 GB or less; the seat lowers the uncompressed cap until it holds
evidence: fresh-page probes of qa/c12/worst-case.pptx (file 99.5 MiB, 2,000 members, 29.8 MB XML): total 150 MiB heap 1,674 MB; 120 MiB 1,314 MB; 130 MiB 1,384 MB, twice
result: heap 1,384 MB, 116 MB under the bar; 140 MiB would sit at the bar by the 12 MB-per-MB slope

decision: worst case regenerated for both rev 5 caps: random filler (reachable) fills the file, compressible media fills the uncompressed total
why: with a 100 MB file and a lower total, both caps bind at once; an unreachable filler would be dropped by python-pptx and understate the fill

decision: hkust-template14 now runs with the other real templates in C12; the raised-cap scratch override is gone
why: it reads under the rev 5 file cap

decision: no engine change to free copies in fill at its memory peak; MAX_TOTAL stays 130 MB
why: Fable's call at rev 5 acceptance: 130 MB uncompressed beside a 100 MB file is enough, and freeing copies at the peak adds risk for no user gain
evidence: Fable message after 0365e00; spec History rev 5
